prompt:
가은(여자, 20대)은 기억을 지울 수 있는 능력이 있다. 기억을 지우는 방법은 간단하다. 상대방의 맨 살을 잡고 눈을 감으면 된다. 그럼 가은과 상대방 모두 경직 상태가 되며 상대의 기억이 가은에게 넘어온다.

가은이  눈 앞 남자1(30)의 팔을 움켜쥔다. 경직된 남자. 가은은 눈을 감은 채 힘들다는 듯 꿈들거린다.

이때, 멀리서 누군가를 찾는 듯 두리번거리는 해원(여자, 20대). 해원의 시야에 가은이 들어온다. 

가은은 남자의 팔을 놓고 장갑을 낀다. 남자가 혼란스러워 하는 사이 가은이 뒤를 돌자, 눈앞에 해원이 나타난다.
해원과 가은은 서로를 응시한다. 해원이 저벅저벅 가은에게 다가간다.

environment.overview: A contemporary civic pedestrian arcade of weathered concrete, matte steel, and pale stone has a restrained silver-to-charcoal palette under flat, overcast daylight.

zones.name: Pillar Bay
zones.description: A shallow recess with a bare concrete rear wall, a low stone bench, a broad square pillar at one edge, and pale paving extending through its open mouth; the adjoining walkway is directly visible through that opening

zones.name: Long Walk
zones.description: A straight pedestrian passage with a flat concrete canopy, repeating square supports, pale paving seams, and a low steel railing along its open side; overcast sky appears beyond the railing, and the Pillar Bay opening is visible between the supports

baseline.lighting: soft lateral daylight beneath the canopy, with gentle shadows and no direct sun.

breakdown.logline: Gaeun tries to finish erasing a man’s memory through bare-skin contact despite the strain of absorbing it, but Haewon spots her, confronts her as she turns away, and advances into a silent standoff.

beats.summary: Gaeun seizes the man’s exposed forearm, establishing the contact her ability requires
Gaeun closes her eyes, and both bodies lock as the memory transfer begins
A small involuntary tremor reveals the transfer’s physical cost to Gaeun
Haewon enters view searching for someone, introducing the possibility of discovery
Haewon’s searching gaze settles on Gaeun
Gaeun breaks contact, leaving the man visibly confused
Gaeun covers her bare hands with gloves, restoring a barrier against contact
Gaeun turns and discovers Haewon directly in front of her
Neither woman looks away, transforming the encounter into a confrontation
Haewon walks toward Gaeun, collapsing the space between them

subjects.name: Gaeun
subjects.appearance: short, slim build; charcoal, slightly flared mid-thigh coat over dark straight trousers; bare hands; blunt chin-length black bob
signature_features: compact triangular coat silhouette and short, blunt hair outline recognizable from every angle.

subjects.name: Man 1
subjects.appearance: stocky build; light-gray shirt with sleeves rolled above the elbows; dark trousers; short dark hair
signature_features: broad, heavy torso and thick exposed forearms give him a distinctive bulky silhouette from every angle.

subjects.name: Haewon
subjects.appearance: tall, slender build; pale-gray, straight knee-length coat over charcoal trousers; dark hair tied in a low ponytail
signature_features: elongated column-like silhouette, substantially taller than Gaeun, with a narrow coat outline recognizable from every angle.

subjects.name: Gloves
subjects.appearance: matte charcoal fabric, full fingers, short straight cuffs, no decoration
signature_features: matching narrow five-finger silhouettes with sharply squared cuff edges.

spec.emotion: Apprehension at an intimate but forceful contact.
spec.transition: Hard cut closer along the same viewing axis.

Location: Covered outdoor public walkway.
Atmosphere: Late afternoon, dry and overcast, soft lateral daylight beneath the canopy, with gentle shadows and no direct sun.
This cut happens at Pillar Bay: A shallow recess with a bare concrete rear wall, a low stone bench, a broad square pillar at one edge, and pale paving extending through its open mouth; the adjoining walkway is directly visible through that opening
Backdrop, behind the action: Gaeun’s charcoal coat front and a small patch of pale bay paving.
Shot size: insert
Camera angle: High, oblique view of Gaeun’s hands
In frame, each seen from the camera angle above and facing as the action requires:
- Gaeun (Woman in her twenties): short, slim build; charcoal, slightly flared mid-thigh coat over dark straight trousers; bare hands; blunt chin-length black bob Signature, drawn only where this angle exposes it: compact triangular coat silhouette and short, blunt hair outline recognizable from every angle. Current state in this cut: Her right hand is fully gloved; her left hand is inside the second glove, whose cuff is being pulled over the wrist.
- Gloves (Pair of fitted gloves): matte charcoal fabric, full fingers, short straight cuffs, no decoration Signature, drawn only where this angle exposes it: matching narrow five-finger silhouettes with sharply squared cuff edges.
Action: With her already gloved right hand, Gaeun draws the second glove’s cuff snugly over her left wrist, covering the remaining strip of bare skin.
Mood: Guarded relief as she seals off contact.
